newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Rap singers sentenced to jail term for using song lyrics attacking the police.

-- A Senate decision to submit stock options to mandatory social security contributions may have a negative impact on small innovative firms who rely oh stock options to attract high level managers without paying high salaries.
-- Government postpones privatisation of GAN unit CIC, Finance Ministry asks bank's 11 regional chairmen for proposals.
-- Unions at SNCF railway operator call for further negotiation of rail reform.
-- Ivory Coast to privatise telecommunications, after launching cellular phone services. France Telecom is among three candidates to bid for privatised Citelcom network.
-- Cie de Suez may announce in the next few days the name of the chosen bidder for part of its real-estate portfolio.
